name: Template: Customer Success
description: Track account health from onboarding through expansion and renewal. Each swimlane represents a customer segment.

swimlanes.name: Americas
swimlanes.notes: US + Canada + LATAM accounts. CSM: Alex Rivera.

swimlanes.name: EMEA
swimlanes.notes: Europe, Middle East, Africa. CSM: Jordan Patel.

swimlanes.name: APAC
swimlanes.notes: Australia, Japan, SE Asia. CSM: Morgan Wu.

swimlanes.name: Enterprise Accounts
swimlanes.notes: 200+ seat strategic accounts managed directly by VP CS.

swimlanes.name: Strategic Partners
swimlanes.notes: Channel and technology partners. Joint success plans. CSM: Riley Kim.

swimlanes.name: Government & Edu
swimlanes.notes: Public sector accounts. Longer procurement, stricter compliance. CSM: Sam Torres.

swimlanes.name: Healthcare
swimlanes.notes: HIPAA-compliant accounts. PHI handling required. CSM: Casey Park.

swimlanes.name: Financial Services
swimlanes.notes: SOC 2 and regulatory compliance required. CSM: Drew Martinez.

swimlanes.name: Startup & SMB
swimlanes.notes: Sub-20-seat accounts. Tech-touch CSM model. Automated health scoring.

swimlanes.name: Agency & Creative
swimlanes.notes: Creative agencies and studios. High board count, low seat count. CSM: Avery Chen.
